newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sept S&P 500s end sharply higher, near highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sept S&P 500s end sharply higher, near highs.

text.p: June 12 - U.S. Sept S&P 500 futures ended sharply higher, off all-time peaks but at record settle. Traders said closing buying lifted S&Ps again after brief gain-cutting when T-bond futures closed. Some see 900.00 in cash S&Ps soon. Technicals, strong bonds when weak retail sales fed ideas of no rate hike, powered momentum. May US PPI seen up 0.1 pct overall, core.
